tasks.title: Promote staged board migrations into the live migrations/ tree
tasks.dod: all six paired migrations apply cleanly in order against the live migrate-go-up and revert cleanly in reverse order via migrate-go-down

tasks.title: Model board domain entities and sentinel errors
tasks.dod: unit tests for Task construction reject an empty title (AC-02) and pass for a non-empty one; Board/Column/Task/PublicLink types carry no framework imports

tasks.title: Implement Postgres repository for board, columns, tasks, public_links
tasks.dod: integration tests (dbtest + testcontainers) cover: insert task into the leftmost column (AC-01), update a task's column_id (AC-04), reject a move to a non-existent column_id via FK/lookup (AC-05), and hard-delete a task (AC-06)

tasks.title: Implement in-process SSE hub with per-token connection registry
tasks.dod: unit tests confirm a broadcast reaches every registered connection, and closing a token's registry entry closes exactly its connections (supports AC-11 revocation in T9) — derives from sad.md §6 (ADR-0002) and events.md connection-lifecycle section

tasks.title: Implement task use-cases: create, edit, move, delete
tasks.dod: unit tests (repo faked via the ports interface) cover: create in leftmost column (AC-01), reject empty title (AC-02), edit title/assignee (AC-03), move to a valid column (AC-04), reject move to an invalid column (AC-05), delete (AC-06); each mutation returns a signal for the caller to broadcast (ADR-0002)

tasks.title: Implement public-link and board-state use-cases
tasks.dod: unit tests cover: issue a link when none is active (AC-07), reject issuing a second active link (409 case), revoke the active link (AC-08), fetch board state by valid token (AC-09), and reject a revoked/unknown token (AC-11)

tasks.title: Add HTTP handlers for task CRUD + move, with rate limiting on create
tasks.dod: handler tests cover POST/PATCH/DELETE/move against openapi.yaml's documented status codes (201/200/204/404/422), the create endpoint enforces the ≤30/min per-client token-bucket limit (spec §6.1, 429 per openapi.yaml), and mapError translates every T5 sentinel error to the documented apperr code

tasks.title: Add HTTP handlers for board state and public-link issue/revoke
tasks.dod: handler tests cover GET /api/v1/board (BoardState incl. public_link presence), POST /api/v1/board/public-link (201, 409 when already active), DELETE /api/v1/board/public-link (204, 404 when none active) — matching openapi.yaml

tasks.title: Add SSE endpoints for team-editor and public-viewer live updates
tasks.dod: handler test confirms GET /api/v1/board/events and GET /api/v1/public/{token}/events register the connection with the SSE hub (T4) keyed by token/global, emit board.state_changed.v1 per events.md, and that DELETE /api/v1/board/public-link synchronously closes every connection registered under the revoked token (AC-11)

tasks.title: Add public-viewer HTTP handlers for read-only board access by token
tasks.dod: handler tests cover GET /api/v1/public/{token}/board returning PublicBoardState for a valid token (AC-09) and 404 board.link_invalid for a revoked/unknown token (AC-11); the public router registers no mutating routes, so drag/edit/delete attempts have no endpoint to reach (AC-10, enforced structurally)

tasks.title: Wire the board module into main.go and register routes
tasks.dod: board.New(...) constructs the module from its infra/app/ports layers and returns a *ports.Handler; cmd/api/main.go registers it as a RouteRegistrar with no authMW (ADR-0001 — board is deliberately unauthenticated); `make -C api run` boots and GET /api/v1/board returns 200

tasks.title: Write integration tests for concurrent move and link-revocation invariants
tasks.dod: an integration test (`-tags integration`) fires two concurrent MoveTask calls for the same task to different columns and asserts the final column matches whichever write landed last, with no lost update beyond that (AC-05b, sad.md §10 QG-2); a second integration test opens an SSE connection on a token, revokes the link, and asserts the connection is closed synchronously (AC-11, sad.md §6 Flow 3)

tasks.title: Build the board feature's typed API client and SSE subscription hook
tasks.dod: unit tests cover the typed calls (getBoard, createTask, editTask, moveTask, deleteTask) built on the existing shared/api/client.ts pattern (error mapping via showApiError) and an EventSource-wrapping hook that triggers a board refetch on board.state_changed (events.md); reuses the client, adds no new HTTP layer

tasks.title: Build drag-and-drop board state with optimistic updates
tasks.dod: component/unit tests cover: dropping a task on a valid column optimistically moves it and calls the move API (AC-04), dropping outside any valid column leaves the task in place with no API call (AC-05), and a failed API call rolls the optimistic update back

tasks.title: Build task card, column, and quick-add UI components
tasks.dod: component tests cover: quick-add in the leftmost column creates a task and shows it immediately (AC-01, SCR-02), submitting an empty title shows the required-name error inline and does not call the API (AC-02); components reuse shared/ui Card, Input, Button — no new primitives introduced

tasks.title: Build the edit-task modal (title, assignee, save, delete)
tasks.dod: component tests cover: editing title/assignee and saving updates the card immediately (AC-03, SCR-03), deleting from the modal removes the task from the board (AC-06); reuses shared/ui Dialog, Input, Button — no new primitives

tasks.title: Build the public-link panel feature (issue/revoke)
tasks.dod: component tests cover: no active link shows an 'issue link' action that displays the returned URL on success (AC-07, SCR-04), an active link shows a 'revoke' action that clears the panel back to the no-link state on success (AC-08); reuses shared/ui Popover, Button, Badge — no new primitives

tasks.title: Assemble the team-editor board page and register its route
tasks.dod: pages/board composes features/board (columns + cards + quick-add + edit modal) and features/public-link (SCR-04 entry point) with no business logic of its own (CLAUDE.md — pages assemble, don't hold logic); registered in web/src/routes.ts as the default product page and reachable via `npm run dev`

tasks.title: Assemble the public read-only board page and its unavailable-link state
tasks.dod: component test covers: a valid token renders columns/tasks read-only with no drag handlers or edit/delete affordances rendered (AC-09, AC-10, SCR-05); an invalid/revoked token renders the 'link unavailable' state instead of the board (AC-11, SCR-06); registered in web/src/routes.ts at the public link path
